title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful Vietnamese-inspired chicken noodle soup made with fresh herbs and springy noodles.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the springy noodles to the pot and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
